name: PROJECT_REGISTER
title: MC GROUP Evidence & Execution System — Project Register

source_of_truth.product_catalog: Existing Registry/products.json (path, schema, and availability must be verified before integration)

purpose: Define a project-scoped execution index for MC GROUP work. This file is not the product Registry, is not a replacement for it, and does not assert that projects or integrations are live.

governance.record_scope: Projects and execution initiatives only; do not use this register to create canonical products, brands, or organizational entities.
governance.registry_rule: Reference existing product Registry identifiers when applicable. Do not copy the product catalog, create a parallel product Registry, or write to the existing Registry from this file.
governance.authority: Each project owner is accountable for the accuracy of their project records, subject to MC GROUP governance and access controls.
governance.priority_rule: P1-P4 records organizational priority only and does not grant authorization or access.
governance.status_rule: Keep workflow, verification, deployment, and artifact maturity as separate status dimensions, following STATUS_DICTIONARY.yaml.
governance.privacy_rule: Do not include secrets, Vault contents, sensitive personal information, or unrestricted evidence payloads in this register.
governance.evidence_rule: Link to authorized evidence records and source locations; do not treat this register as the evidence repository or proof of deployment.

record_schema.description: Conceptual project-record contract. These names are not asserted fields in FILE 01 or in the existing product Registry; validate against the chosen storage schema before implementation.

fields.project_id: Stable project-scoped identifier; must not be confused with a Registry product ID.
fields.project_name: Project or initiative display name under the MC GROUP canonical structure.
fields.summary: Short, non-sensitive description of scope and intended outcome.
fields.owner_org_unit: MC GROUP canonical organizational area or approved project owner group.
fields.project_owner: Accountable owner identifier; use only authorized display information.
fields.contributors: Optional list of authorized contributor identifiers; do not imply access from listing a person here.
fields.priority: P1 | P2 | P3 | P4; priority only, never an authorization value.
fields.registry_product_refs: List of stable identifiers referencing existing Registry entries; empty if no applicable product link is verified.
fields.verification_status: One of STATUS_DICTIONARY.yaml verification codes, or null until applicable.
fields.deployment_status: One of STATUS_DICTIONARY.yaml deployment codes, or null until applicable.
fields.artifact_maturity: One of STATUS_DICTIONARY.yaml artifact maturity codes.
fields.environment: LOCAL | TEST | STAGING | PRODUCTION | null; identifies scope only and does not assert environment availability.
fields.target_date: ISO 8601 date or null; planned date only.
fields.last_reviewed_at: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone or null.
fields.evidence_refs: Authorized references to evidence records; do not embed sensitive evidence payloads.
fields.related_work_item_refs: Optional identifiers for tasks tracked in the execution workflow.
fields.risk_summary: Optional non-sensitive summary; keep detailed restricted risks in their authorized source.
fields.record_status: ACTIVE | ON_HOLD | COMPLETED | CANCELLED | ARCHIVED; a register lifecycle label, not a workflow status or deployment claim.
fields.source_refs: References to authoritative records or documentation, with access appropriate to the viewer.

record_status_dictionary.ACTIVE: Project is currently tracked as active; does not mean work is actively in progress.
record_status_dictionary.ON_HOLD: Project tracking is paused by an authorized decision; record the reason and review point.
record_status_dictionary.COMPLETED: Project-level scope has been accepted by its authorized owner; does not imply deployment or verification unless those statuses independently support the claim.
record_status_dictionary.CANCELLED: Project was stopped by an authorized decision; preserve history and rationale.
record_status_dictionary.ARCHIVED: Project record is retained for traceability and is no longer part of the active register view.

validation_rules: project_id must be unique within the project register and must not be reused as a product Registry identifier.
Every non-null registry_product_refs entry must resolve to an existing Registry record after the Registry path and schema are verified.
Do not create a Registry record as a side effect of adding a project record.
Validate each status code against STATUS_DICTIONARY.yaml; reject unknown codes rather than coercing them to a success state.
Do not infer project completion from workflow status, deployment status, or a target date alone.
Do not mark deployment as verified without environment-specific deployment and post-deployment evidence.
Record status changes and consequential edits as auditable events using the verified evidence/workflow mechanism.
Use null or an explicit unknown value for unverified facts; do not invent owners, dates, Registry IDs, or system state.
Apply authorization before returning records to dashboards, APIs, exports, or AI agents.

access_model.public_access: No project records are public by default.
access_model.admin_access: Owner-only administration is a requirement from FILE 00; actual MFA and enforcement remain unverified.
access_model.ai_access: Provide only task-scoped, least-privilege project fields needed for an approved task; never expose secrets or unrelated private data.
access_model.exports: Restrict and audit exports according to the approved access policy; omit sensitive fields by default.

integration_constraints: The existing Registry/products.json remains the product catalog source of truth; its presence, location, schema, and consumers were not verified in the inspected repository snapshot.
This project register is a separate project execution index and must not be represented as the Registry or as a substitute for it.
FILE 01 was not present in the inspected repository tree; locate and review its actual schema before mapping evidence_refs or implementing persistence.
Before implementation, define a validated storage format, ownership, access control, change history, backup, and recovery approach with the authorized owner.
Use additive, versioned integration and a non-production test fixture where possible; require compatibility checks and rollback planning before approved writes to existing systems.
FILE 04 may derive authorized summary views from this register only after the actual source, schema, and access controls are verified.

initial_data_state.interpretation: No project records are asserted by this template. An empty records array means no records are populated here; it does not mean MC GROUP has no projects.

change_log.change: Initial project execution register contract; intentionally contains no project entries and does not duplicate the product Registry.
